t: The Timeguard SLW360N is a robust indoor PIR sensor, engineered for reliable motion detection and presence sensing in various commercial and domestic settings. Offers adjustable time-on and lux settings, alongside a manual override for precise control over lighting circuits. Compact, low-profile design fits seamlessly with BESA boxes for straightforward installation, making it an ideal choice for electricians fitting out corridors, offices, or utility spaces. 60° detection angle, up to 8m diameter, for motion and 4m diameter for presence at a 2.5m mounting height. Suitable for 2000W resistive, 500W LED/fluorescent or low energy loads or 75W fan.
